en: Piper
Ace Trainer Piper: The water here is where Horsea learn to be dragons. Watch them!

en: Ace Trainer Piper: They have a lot more to learn.

en: Twins Clea: We'll train together some more.
text: Gemene Clea: Ne mai antrenăm împreună.

en: Gil
